Earlier, WhatsApp allowed iPhone users to add a second account within the same app. Now, WhatsApp is expanding support to up to three accounts. Here are the details.

WhatsApp will support up to three accounts

Last June, WhatsApp officially launched its multi-account support feature on iPhone, allowing users to add a second account within the same app.

After several months of beta testing, the feature was officially launched, freeing users from relying on WhatsApp Business to manage a second account.

According to WABetaInfo, the app is now developing an expansion of this feature, allowing users to switch between three accounts without having to log out.

WABetaInfo reports:

The report added that each account will retain its own chat history, notifications, privacy settings, backups, and media content.

WABetaInfo noted that while two accounts are sufficient for many users, this feature will be very useful for those who juggle multiple combinations of work and personal phone numbers.

However, the feature is still in development and has not yet been opened to beta testers, meaning it will take some time before a wider rollout.
